infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Work kms uses your location to measure the distance of work trips.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Work kms measures work trips. If you turn on drive detection, it notices when you start driving and measures the trip, even with the app closed. Location is only kept for business trips you choose to save.
